title: Lisse purity of the transported complex
statement:
Let $C_0$ be a smooth geometrically connected affine curve, let
$C'_0$ be a smooth geometrically connected curve containing $C_0$
as a dense open with finite complement, let
$g:C'_0\to\mathbf A^1_{k_0}$ be a finite generically etale morphism,
let $j:C_0\hookrightarrow C'_0$, and let $\mathcal F$ be lisse and
punctually $\iota$-pure of weight $w$ on $C_0$. Put
$\mathcal K:=g_*j_!\mathcal F$ and let $B$ be the branch locus of
$g$. Then the restriction $\mathcal K|_W$ to
$W:=\mathbf A^1_{k_0}\setminus(B\cup g(C'_0\setminus C_0))$
is lisse and punctually $\iota$-pure of weight $w$.

proof.text: Put $W=\mathbf A^1_{k_0}\setminus(B\cup g(C'_0\setminus C_0))$; $B$ is finite because $g$ is finite and generically étale between curves, and $C'_0\setminus C_0$ is finite, so $W$ is a dense open. By the definition of the branch locus (the image of the closed set of points where $g$ is not étale), the base change $g_W:g^{-1}(W)\to W$ is finite (base change of a finite morphism) and étale at every point. If $x\in g^{-1}(W)$ and $x\notin C_0$, then $g(x)\in g(C'_0\setminus C_0)$, which $W$ avoids; hence $g^{-1}(W)\subseteq C_0$. Restriction to the open $g^{-1}(W)\subseteq C_0$ gives $(j_!\mathcal F)|_{g^{-1}(W)}=\mathcal F|_{g^{-1}(W)}$, and restriction of a direct image to an open of the target is the direct image of the restriction, $(g_*j_!\mathcal F)|_W=(g_W)_*(\mathcal F|_{g^{-1}(W)})$, compatibly with the Weil structures; so $\mathcal K|_W$ is the finite étale pushforward of $\mathcal F|_{g^{-1}(W)}$. That restriction is again a lisse Weil sheaf, and it is punctually $\iota$-pure of weight $w$, since the closed points of $g^{-1}(W)$ are closed points of $C_0$ with the same residue fields and Frobenius eigenvalues [def-weil-punctual-weights]. The lissity of $\mathcal K|_W$ follows from [lem-a1-finite-map-lisse] applied to $g_W$, and its punctual purity of weight $w$ from [lem-a1-finite-map-purity] applied to $g_W$ and the definition of punctual purity in [def-weil-punctual-weights].
